name: Wheat
water: 4–6 irrigations: crown root, tillering, jointing, flowering, milking
fertilizer: 120 kg N, 60 kg P2O5, 40 kg K2O per ha; half the N at sowing
tips: Sow by mid-November for the best yield; each week of delay after that costs about 30–40 kg/ha.
Use certified seed treated with a fungicide.
Irrigate at crown root initiation (20–25 days after sowing) without fail.

problems.name: Yellow rust
problems.symptoms: Yellow stripes of powdery spores along leaves, leaves dry early
problems.prevention: Grow resistant varieties, avoid late sowing, scout from January
problems.cure: Spray propiconazole 25% EC at 1 ml/litre at first sign

problems.name: Aphids
problems.symptoms: Clusters of small green insects on ears and leaves, sticky honeydew
problems.cure: Spray imidacloprid 17.8 SL at 0.5 ml/litre or neem oil 5 ml/litre

name: Rice (Paddy)
soil: Clay or clay loam that holds standing water
water: 5 cm standing water through tillering; drain 10 days before harvest
fertilizer: 120 kg N, 60 kg P2O5, 40 kg K2O per ha; N in three splits
tips: Nursery in June, transplant 25–30 day old seedlings.
Alternate wetting and drying saves up to 25% water.
Harvest when 80% of grains turn straw-coloured.

problems.name: Blast
problems.symptoms: Spindle-shaped leaf spots with grey centres, neck of panicle turns black
problems.prevention: Avoid excess nitrogen, use resistant varieties, treat seed

problems.name: Stem borer
problems.symptoms: Dead central shoot in young plants, white empty panicles later
problems.prevention: Clip seedling tips before transplanting, use light traps

name: Maize
water: Critical at knee-high, tasseling and grain filling; waterlogging kills seedlings
fertilizer: 120 kg N, 60 kg P2O5, 40 kg K2O per ha
tips: Sow on ridges so excess rain drains away.
Keep rows 60 cm apart and plants 20 cm apart.
Earth up at 30 days to prevent lodging.

problems.name: Fall armyworm
problems.symptoms: Ragged leaf holes, sawdust-like frass in the whorl
problems.prevention: Seed treatment, early sowing, pheromone traps
problems.cure: Spray emamectin benzoate 5 SG at 0.4 g/litre into the whorl

problems.name: Turcicum leaf blight
problems.symptoms: Long grey-green cigar-shaped lesions on leaves
problems.prevention: Resistant hybrids, crop rotation, remove residue

name: Cotton
soil: Deep black or alluvial soil with good drainage
water: 6–8 irrigations; avoid stress at flowering and boll formation
fertilizer: 100 kg N, 50 kg P2O5, 50 kg K2O per ha
tips: Sow after the first good pre-monsoon rain or with irrigation in April–May.
Pick bolls only when fully open and dry.
Rotate with a cereal to reduce pest build-up.

problems.name: Pink bollworm
problems.symptoms: Rosette flowers, damaged bolls with pink larvae inside
problems.prevention: Short-duration varieties, destroy stalks after harvest, pheromone traps
problems.cure: Spray profenofos 50 EC at 2 ml/litre on economic threshold

problems.name: Leaf curl virus
problems.symptoms: Upward curling, thickened veins, stunted plants
problems.prevention: Control whitefly, remove weeds and infected plants
problems.cure: Spray diafenthiuron 50 WP at 1 g/litre to stop whitefly spread

name: Mustard
soil: Light to medium loam, neutral pH
fertilizer: 80 kg N, 40 kg P2O5, 40 kg S per ha
tips: Sow in the first fortnight of October.
Thin to 10–15 cm between plants at 3 weeks.
Harvest when 75% of pods turn yellow-brown.

problems.name: Mustard aphid
problems.symptoms: Dense colonies on flower spikes, shrivelled pods

problems.name: White rust
problems.symptoms: White blister-like pustules under leaves, swollen distorted flowers
problems.prevention: Resistant varieties, seed treatment with metalaxyl
problems.cure: Spray mancozeb 2.5 g/litre at first symptoms

name: Tomato
soil: Well-drained sandy loam rich in organic matter
water: Light irrigation every 5–7 days; drip is best
fertilizer: 120 kg N, 80 kg P2O5, 60 kg K2O per ha plus 20 t FYM
tips: Raise seedlings in a nursery and transplant after 25 days.
Stake plants to keep fruit off the soil.
Mulch to hold moisture and cut weeds.

problems.name: Early blight
problems.symptoms: Brown rings like a target on older leaves, leaf drop
problems.prevention: Crop rotation, remove infected leaves, drip not overhead water

problems.name: Fruit borer
problems.symptoms: Round holes in fruit, caterpillar inside

name: Sugarcane
soil: Deep, well-drained loam or clay loam
water: Every 7–10 days in summer, 20–25 days in winter
fertilizer: 150 kg N, 60 kg P2O5, 60 kg K2O per ha
tips: Use 3-budded setts treated with a fungicide.
Trash mulching conserves water.
Harvest close to the ground; the base holds the most sugar.

problems.name: Red rot
problems.symptoms: Reddish stalk interior with white cross bands, sour smell
problems.prevention: Disease-free setts, resistant varieties, avoid ratooning infected fields
problems.cure: Remove and burn infected clumps; dip setts in carbendazim 1 g/litre

problems.name: Early shoot borer
problems.symptoms: Dead heart in young shoots that pulls out easily
problems.prevention: Early planting, earth up at 60 days
